cn.description:
当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。

谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。

「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。

班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。

—— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 ——
• 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理
• 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型）
• 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理
• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用
• 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快

—— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 ——
• 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录
• 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室
• 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯
• 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考

—— 作业反馈 / 收作业 ——
• 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀
• 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」
• 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享
• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

—— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 ——
• 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生
• 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看
• Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表
• 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦

—— 课程表 / 调课助手 ——
• 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表
• 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表
• 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习
• 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周
• 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出
• 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案

—— 座位表 / 智能排座 ——
• 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座
• 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着）
• 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖
• 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向）
• 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴

—— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 ——
• 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到
• 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库
• 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档

—— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 ——
• 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历
• 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间
• 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加
• 倒数日：考试、开学、放假、节日倒计时，重要日子不再靠人肉记

—— 值日安排 / 工作留痕 / 班级建设 ——
• 值日分组轮换；组内可指定岗位（如组长、扫地等），支持调整顺序与一键均分
• 今日值日一目了然，适合早读前、放学后快速核对
• 工作留痕：家访、班会、家长沟通随时记；可附照片、视频、语音，应对检查少翻聊天记录
• 班级建设：班训、班规、班委会、活动荣誉、板报照片入库，班级文化有处放

—— 学生积分（可选开启）——
• 点名加减分、规则可配
• 段位、宠物等激励方式，让日常管理更有参与感
• 适合平时表现量化、小组竞赛、课堂激励

—— 备份、导出与多端 ——
• 「我的」整包备份导出压缩包，换手机、换电脑再导入
• 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控
• 现已支持 Mac 桌面版：左侧功能栏 + 右侧工作区，宽屏办公更适合备课、改成绩、排座位、导出名单
• 与 iPhone 版能力对齐，备份可互通（按你实际导出导入使用）

—— 特别说明 ——
• 本 App 面向教师自用班务管理，不是教育局官方学籍系统，不能代替成绩证明、学籍证明
• 学生姓名、电话、身份证号、家庭信息等由你本地保管；备份文件请勿发到公开群或网盘公开链接
• 相机、相册、麦克风、通知、日历等权限仅在使用对应功能时申请，可随时在系统设置关闭
• 适合小学班主任、初中班主任、高中班主任、中职班主任，以及需要管班的任课教师、实习教师

一句话总结：把点名册、成绩表、座位表、作业名单、课表、评语、值日表、家访记录，从零散表格和微信里收进一个「班主任班级管理」工具里——本地、好用、能导出、能备份，手机和电脑都能干活。

cn.description:
SessionBand Jazz Fusion – Tom Cawley Special Synth & Vintage Keys Edition

Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app.

With over 20,000 precision-cut, chord-based loops across 15 diverse Jazz Fusion styles included, the app instantly converts the chords you select into great-sounding audio - wherever you are and whatever your ability. Perfect for songwriters and producers and the ultimate play-along for jazz rock and pop instrumentalists.

Highly acclaimed, multi award-winning pianist Tom Cawley is one of the most sought-after keyboard players in the world both as a jazz pianist (Dave Weckl, Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker...), and as a leading pop/rock keyboardist, recording and performing around the world with U2, Peter Gabriel, Andrea Bocelli, Amy Winehouse and many others.

For this special Jazz Fusion edition, Tom is joined by 2 of the world's top session musicians: Simon Lea – Drums (Rod Stewart, Dionne Warwick, James Blunt, James Morrison, Katie Melua...) and Geoff Gascoyne – Bass (Sting, Van Morrison, Georgie Fame...).

Tom's passion for jazz and for modern and vintage keys is reflected in the diverse range of styles in this edition. And Tom has employed many of the best keyboards from his vast personal collection: from the Oberheim OB-6, Prophet 12 and Moog Model D (as well as a modular set-up), to his vintage Fender Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Hohner Pianet - they all feature in the content of this app. And to do full justice to this genre, we have increased the number of chord variations to 15 for every root note in all 15 styles!

Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier.

Create professional Jazz Fusion to your own choice of chords in minutes. Everything you need to create and share thousands of stunning royalty-free tracks.

hk.description:
当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。

谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。

「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。

班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。

—— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 ——
• 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理
• 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型）
• 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理
• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用
• 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快

—— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 ——
• 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录
• 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室
• 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯
• 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考

—— 作业反馈 / 收作业 ——
• 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀
• 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」
• 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享
• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

—— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 ——
• 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生
• 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看
• Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表
• 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦

—— 课程表 / 调课助手 ——
• 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表
• 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表
• 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习
• 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周
• 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出
• 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案

—— 座位表 / 智能排座 ——
• 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座
• 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着）
• 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖
• 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向）
• 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴

—— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 ——
• 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到
• 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库
• 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档

—— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 ——
• 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历
• 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间
• 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加
• 倒数日：考试、开学、放假、节日倒计时，重要日子不再靠人肉记

—— 值日安排 / 工作留痕 / 班级建设 ——
• 值日分组轮换；组内可指定岗位（如组长、扫地等），支持调整顺序与一键均分
• 今日值日一目了然，适合早读前、放学后快速核对
• 工作留痕：家访、班会、家长沟通随时记；可附照片、视频、语音，应对检查少翻聊天记录
• 班级建设：班训、班规、班委会、活动荣誉、板报照片入库，班级文化有处放

—— 学生积分（可选开启）——
• 点名加减分、规则可配
• 段位、宠物等激励方式，让日常管理更有参与感
• 适合平时表现量化、小组竞赛、课堂激励

—— 备份、导出与多端 ——
• 「我的」整包备份导出压缩包，换手机、换电脑再导入
• 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控
• 现已支持 Mac 桌面版：左侧功能栏 + 右侧工作区，宽屏办公更适合备课、改成绩、排座位、导出名单
• 与 iPhone 版能力对齐，备份可互通（按你实际导出导入使用）

—— 特别说明 ——
• 本 App 面向教师自用班务管理，不是教育局官方学籍系统，不能代替成绩证明、学籍证明
• 学生姓名、电话、身份证号、家庭信息等由你本地保管；备份文件请勿发到公开群或网盘公开链接
• 相机、相册、麦克风、通知、日历等权限仅在使用对应功能时申请，可随时在系统设置关闭
• 适合小学班主任、初中班主任、高中班主任、中职班主任，以及需要管班的任课教师、实习教师

一句话总结：把点名册、成绩表、座位表、作业名单、课表、评语、值日表、家访记录，从零散表格和微信里收进一个「班主任班级管理」工具里——本地、好用、能导出、能备份，手机和电脑都能干活。

Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app.

hk.description:
這是一款關於生、死、心願與延續的App。

小時候，我以爲自己是不會老去的彼得·潘，卻終究敵不過健康磨損，容顏老去。
時針轉動，生命流逝，但每一次心跳都可以更加有力。

有時候，生命隻是一連串的數字，多少年，多少月，多少小時，多少分鐘。當你意識到這個時，往往陷入巨大的虛無感之中，惶恐不能自拔。
而現在，這些數字可以成爲你重塑生命的坐標，指引你走向更健康、更長久的未來。

生辰 2.0 通過 AI 分析和科學判斷，不僅預測生命的終點，更爲你鋪就延長生命的道路：

- 探索你的生命時鐘：了解當下的預期壽命，直麵生命的有限與珍貴。
- 髮現延壽的可能：看見改變健康習慣能爲你帶來多少額外的生命時光。
- 聚合健康數據：自動追踪睡眠、鍛煉、壓力（HRV）、經期、喝水等十餘種健康數據

美國詩人納·斯待爾在87歲那年冩道：
"如果我能夠從頭活過，我會試着犯更多的錯。
我會放鬆一點，我會靈活一點。
我會爬更多的山，遊更多的河，看更多的日落。"

因爲了解生命的終點，才能更好地珍惜當下的每一刻。生辰2.0 探索健康的可能，讓我們成爲你健康旅程的長久夥伴。

hk.description:
真RTS + MOBA 戰鬥 + SLG微操。

「兵法如棋，局由我定！」 厌倦了數值碾壓與「看戲式」自動戰鬥？《破軍：三國》專為硬核玩家打造，回歸策略初心。這是一款純粹的三國戰略大作，極致融合 SLG 宏大佈局與 RTS 即時操作。在這裡，勝負不看課金額度，只看你的天時、地利與奇謀！

【媒體與玩家好評】 

「知略與操作的頂點，找回了單機時代策略遊戲的尊嚴。」—— 日本專業手遊站 MSY Games 

「這隻遊戲簡直是 RoK 玩家夢寐以求的微操訓練場。」—— 港台資深策略論壇玩家

【為什麼硬核策略迷一致推崇？】

  ▶ 即時指揮：搖桿微操的首創方向輪盤指揮系統，讓你在兵線對推中精準控制英雄切入。背後攻擊加成、前後夾擊收益極大化，利用繞後、包抄親手反敗為勝！

  ▶ 動態氣候：改寫戰場數據的天時地利 天氣不只是視覺。雨天道路泥濘使騎兵移速驟降，大霧是奇襲窗口，雪天雙重削減攻速。掌握天候適應力，讓自然之力為你所用。

  ▶ 奇謀逆轉：兵糧庫系統與心理戰 攻其必救，斷其糧道！攻佔敵方糧倉可瞬間瓦解全軍戰力。配合策反、離間、毒泉等奇謀戰法，實現「白板反殺名將」的史詩快感。

  ▶ 長效經營：內政自動化，下線亦能累積國力 實踐「前線征戰，後方備戰」。內政廳自動產出資源，合適的人事決策將真實回饋至全局國力。離線期間，你的大業仍在運轉。

  ▶ 匠心關卡：如詰棋般的深度戰役 拒絕重複換皮，每一關都是值得反覆琢磨的策略棋局。部署對線、地圖事件、劇情反轉，確保你的霸業征程始終充滿新鮮感。

即刻入主三國，成就你的不世霸業！

MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Begin a gorgeous, hand-drawn quest. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.
It is the year 5000, and the greatest achievements in human history are forgotten. The pyramids, the Mona Lisa, The Fresh Prince of Bel Air – forgotten.
Forgotten by everyone except Henry Dijon and his ragtag team of archaeologists. They left Mars to dig up lost treasures on the wild and inhospitable Planet Earth. Life is sweet, until Henry’s professor is kidnapped, and thing start to get... weird.
Join Henry on a freewheeling adventure through the ruins of our civilization. Ask questions like, “Who was this Sony Walkman? And where did he walk?” Unearth extraordinary relics, rescue Professor Totel, and be the first to enter the legendary city of Mutropolis.
One more thing - the gods of ancient Egypt are real and they’re trying to destroy humanity. - Have fun!

• Full voice over in English, text localizations in Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Korean.

Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

hk.description:
SLOTS & DAGGERS is a roguelike in a slot machine.

Spin the reels, chain symbols into combos, and turn every pull into damage, gold and upgrades. Build your machine run by run, then take it into the dungeon and fight your way through a weird little fantasy world full of goblins, monsters and strange little guys.
Every spin matters. Every symbol you add changes the odds. And every run ends with the same question: one more?

FEATURES
- A slot machine that fights back – build synergies, break the reels, beat the odds
- A weird fantasy world drawn by hand, in all its crude glory
- 4–8 hour campaign with escalating challenges
- Egg Arena – an endless high-score mode for the truly determined
- Retro visuals with a hand-drawn, lo-fi charm
- Crunchy old-school hip hop drum machine soundtrack
- Quick runs, deep builds – perfect for a session on the go
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no real money involved – just the game

Numbers! Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING.

----

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS.
To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.
As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal!
I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,
Friedemann

Clover Pit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!

Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.

- Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups!
- Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode!
- A hellish escape room atmosphere!
- 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck!
- A sinister tale of addiction and escape!

Note on Save Data: This game currently stores progress locally on your device. Please be aware that uninstalling the app (or clearing app data) will delete your save file. Cloud Save & Cross-Device Sync are in development for a future update.

P.S. IS THIS GAMBLING?
No! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money!

hk.description:
自2006年首次亮相以來，《泰坦之旅》吸引了眾多玩家。在《泰坦之旅》世界中，你將在無拘無束的英雄之旅中獲得全方位的體驗！

你的光榮任務是拯救世界！

單靠諸神無法打敗泰坦，所以需要真正的英雄 - 那就是你！你的成功或失敗將決定人類和奧林匹斯山諸神的命運！與你的定制英雄一起，探索希臘、埃及、巴比倫和中國的神秘、遠古世界。征服成群的傳奇生物，掌握各種武器和武術：射箭、劍術或使用強大的魔法！

遊歷古代和北歐神話世界！

當你旅行前往派特農神廟、大金字塔、巴比倫空中花園、長城、塔耳塔洛斯競技場和其他著名景點時，與神話中的野獸戰鬥。遭遇希臘神話中的最大惡棍，探索北歐未知的土地，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國，然後踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程。

在你的光榮道路上，要麼全部得到，要麼一無所有！

每一個挑戰等待著你，你必須擊敗更大更強的敵人，直到達到目標並迫使泰坦屈服！與勇敢的寵物同伴一起投入戰鬥！尋找具有特殊力量的非凡物品，這些物品將增強你的能力，幫助你前進。傳奇之劍、強大的閃電咒語、魔法、弓箭以及力量超乎想像的無數其他寶藏等待著你 - 它們全都可以在你的戰鬥中使用，在可怕的生物中散佈驚駭和恐懼！

你在等什麼？

不同於其他動作角色扮演遊戲，《泰坦之旅：傳奇版》將迷人的神話世界與無盡而刺激的動作融合在一起，正如你對如此引人入勝的遊戲所期待的！

主要特點：

- 在不朽王座下載包的世界中，你將遇到希臘神話中的最大惡棍，勇敢面對地獄犬的攻擊，危害冥河的河岸。你需要解釋盲人提爾西亞斯的預言，與阿伽門農和阿喀琉斯並肩作戰，用奧德修斯的計策征服這個黑暗的新冒險。

- 在諸神黃昏下載包的北歐未知土地上，你將勇敢面對凱爾特人、諾斯曼人和阿斯加迪神靈的領地！

- 在亞特蘭蒂斯下載包，與探險家會面，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國。據說有一把鑰匙藏在伊拉克利翁的日記中，該日記據傳位於腓尼基城市加迪爾。踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程，包括塔耳塔洛斯競技場，進行史詩般的戰鬥！

+ 經過全面技術修改的《泰坦之旅》實施了所有的重要更新，以賦予這部經典之作最佳的遊戲體驗！

在永恆餘燼DLC可在應用內購買的 中殺死巨巫泰肯之後，英雄受到傳說中的堯帝召喚，回到東方著手對付一直肆虐 這片大陸的邪魔威脅。 在追查過程中，英雄和他的同伴們發現，遠古兇獸窮奇的現身並非只是巧合，必定有兇險萬分的陰謀正在醞釀…

+ 擁有《泰坦之旅》基本版的所有玩家請注意：這裡提到的下載包還將作為附加內容發佈以供購買，以便所有粉絲可以升級他們的遊戲以充分享受所有擴展！

《身為警察》（This Is the Police）是一個策略/冒險遊戲，故事背景設定在一個螺旋式圍繞排水系統的城市。在遊戲中你將擔任堅韌不拔的警察局長傑克·博伊德的角色，你將潛入一個關於犯罪和陰謀的深刻故事。傑克會不會拿到一大筆錢安心地退休，亦或是最終會破產...還是更糟？

 - 你的任務很明確：在傑克·博伊德退休之前的180天內賺到50萬美元。怎麼賺？一切由你決定！

 - 決定，決定！《身為警察》（This Is the Police）的故事核心是一個黑暗的故事，以及你該如何破解它。無論你決定什麼，你的選擇都會影響比賽 - 以及傑克博伊德的命運。

- 《黃昏三鏢客》？弗里堡警察局局長能夠應付各種人。遊戲全看你的本事，找到壞人並決定如何處理他們。

 - 履行你的職責。作為弗里堡警察局的負責人，傑克每天都要處理各種各樣的挑戰：應對緊急情況，管理他的警員，保衛部門對抗市政廳和腐敗的市長等等。

 - 執行調查並收集針對弗里堡犯罪團伙的證據。

 - 處理城市中的競爭力量。每個人都可向你提供服務，但每一個都是有代價的。

 - 豐富而完整的配音故事：由《毀滅公爵》的配音演員Jon St. John為傑克·博伊德配音。

MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Begin a gorgeous, hand-drawn quest. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.
It is the year 5000, and the greatest achievements in human history are forgotten. The pyramids, the Mona Lisa, The Fresh Prince of Bel Air – forgotten.
Forgotten by everyone except Henry Dijon and his ragtag team of archaeologists. They left Mars to dig up lost treasures on the wild and inhospitable Planet Earth. Life is sweet, until Henry’s professor is kidnapped, and thing start to get... weird.
Join Henry on a freewheeling adventure through the ruins of our civilization. Ask questions like, “Who was this Sony Walkman? And where did he walk?” Unearth extraordinary relics, rescue Professor Totel, and be the first to enter the legendary city of Mutropolis.
One more thing - the gods of ancient Egypt are real and they’re trying to destroy humanity. - Have fun!

Features
• 50+ hand-drawn scenes, crammed with cute, weird characters.
• Full voice over in English, text localizations in Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Korean.
• Archaeological puzzles with a sci-fi twist.
• TONS OF LOVE!

Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

mo.description:
SLOTS & DAGGERS is a roguelike in a slot machine.

Spin the reels, chain symbols into combos, and turn every pull into damage, gold and upgrades. Build your machine run by run, then take it into the dungeon and fight your way through a weird little fantasy world full of goblins, monsters and strange little guys.
Every spin matters. Every symbol you add changes the odds. And every run ends with the same question: one more?

FEATURES
- A slot machine that fights back – build synergies, break the reels, beat the odds
- A weird fantasy world drawn by hand, in all its crude glory
- 4–8 hour campaign with escalating challenges
- Egg Arena – an endless high-score mode for the truly determined
- Retro visuals with a hand-drawn, lo-fi charm
- Crunchy old-school hip hop drum machine soundtrack
- Quick runs, deep builds – perfect for a session on the go
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no real money involved – just the game

Numbers! Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING.

----

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS.
To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.
As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal!
I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,
Friedemann

mo.description:
自2006年首次亮相以來，《泰坦之旅》吸引了眾多玩家。在《泰坦之旅》世界中，你將在無拘無束的英雄之旅中獲得全方位的體驗！

你的光榮任務是拯救世界！

單靠諸神無法打敗泰坦，所以需要真正的英雄 - 那就是你！你的成功或失敗將決定人類和奧林匹斯山諸神的命運！與你的定制英雄一起，探索希臘、埃及、巴比倫和中國的神秘、遠古世界。征服成群的傳奇生物，掌握各種武器和武術：射箭、劍術或使用強大的魔法！

遊歷古代和北歐神話世界！

當你旅行前往派特農神廟、大金字塔、巴比倫空中花園、長城、塔耳塔洛斯競技場和其他著名景點時，與神話中的野獸戰鬥。遭遇希臘神話中的最大惡棍，探索北歐未知的土地，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國，然後踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程。

在你的光榮道路上，要麼全部得到，要麼一無所有！

每一個挑戰等待著你，你必須擊敗更大更強的敵人，直到達到目標並迫使泰坦屈服！與勇敢的寵物同伴一起投入戰鬥！尋找具有特殊力量的非凡物品，這些物品將增強你的能力，幫助你前進。傳奇之劍、強大的閃電咒語、魔法、弓箭以及力量超乎想像的無數其他寶藏等待著你 - 它們全都可以在你的戰鬥中使用，在可怕的生物中散佈驚駭和恐懼！

你在等什麼？

不同於其他動作角色扮演遊戲，《泰坦之旅：傳奇版》將迷人的神話世界與無盡而刺激的動作融合在一起，正如你對如此引人入勝的遊戲所期待的！

主要特點：

- 在不朽王座下載包的世界中，你將遇到希臘神話中的最大惡棍，勇敢面對地獄犬的攻擊，危害冥河的河岸。你需要解釋盲人提爾西亞斯的預言，與阿伽門農和阿喀琉斯並肩作戰，用奧德修斯的計策征服這個黑暗的新冒險。

- 在諸神黃昏下載包的北歐未知土地上，你將勇敢面對凱爾特人、諾斯曼人和阿斯加迪神靈的領地！

- 在亞特蘭蒂斯下載包，與探險家會面，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國。據說有一把鑰匙藏在伊拉克利翁的日記中，該日記據傳位於腓尼基城市加迪爾。踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程，包括塔耳塔洛斯競技場，進行史詩般的戰鬥！

+ 經過全面技術修改的《泰坦之旅》實施了所有的重要更新，以賦予這部經典之作最佳的遊戲體驗！

在永恆餘燼DLC可在應用內購買的 中殺死巨巫泰肯之後，英雄受到傳說中的堯帝召喚，回到東方著手對付一直肆虐 這片大陸的邪魔威脅。 在追查過程中，英雄和他的同伴們發現，遠古兇獸窮奇的現身並非只是巧合，必定有兇險萬分的陰謀正在醞釀…

+ 擁有《泰坦之旅》基本版的所有玩家請注意：這裡提到的下載包還將作為附加內容發佈以供購買，以便所有粉絲可以升級他們的遊戲以充分享受所有擴展！

mo.description:
《身為警察》（This Is the Police）是一個策略/冒險遊戲，故事背景設定在一個螺旋式圍繞排水系統的城市。在遊戲中你將擔任堅韌不拔的警察局長傑克·博伊德的角色，你將潛入一個關於犯罪和陰謀的深刻故事。傑克會不會拿到一大筆錢安心地退休，亦或是最終會破產...還是更糟？

 - 你的任務很明確：在傑克·博伊德退休之前的180天內賺到50萬美元。怎麼賺？一切由你決定！

 - 決定，決定！《身為警察》（This Is the Police）的故事核心是一個黑暗的故事，以及你該如何破解它。無論你決定什麼，你的選擇都會影響比賽 - 以及傑克博伊德的命運。

- 《黃昏三鏢客》？弗里堡警察局局長能夠應付各種人。遊戲全看你的本事，找到壞人並決定如何處理他們。

 - 履行你的職責。作為弗里堡警察局的負責人，傑克每天都要處理各種各樣的挑戰：應對緊急情況，管理他的警員，保衛部門對抗市政廳和腐敗的市長等等。

 - 執行調查並收集針對弗里堡犯罪團伙的證據。

 - 處理城市中的競爭力量。每個人都可向你提供服務，但每一個都是有代價的。

 - 豐富而完整的配音故事：由《毀滅公爵》的配音演員Jon St. John為傑克·博伊德配音。

tw.trackCensoredName: 我不想当班主任-班主任工作台&教师工作台&班级管理
tw.description:
当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。

谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。

「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。

班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。

—— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 ——
• 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理
• 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型）
• 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理
• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用
• 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快

—— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 ——
• 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录
• 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室
• 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯
• 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考

—— 作业反馈 / 收作业 ——
• 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀
• 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」
• 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享
• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

—— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 ——
• 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生
• 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看
• Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表
• 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦

—— 课程表 / 调课助手 ——
• 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表
• 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表
• 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习
• 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周
• 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出
• 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案

—— 座位表 / 智能排座 ——
• 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座
• 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着）
• 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖
• 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向）
• 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴

—— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 ——
• 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到
• 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库
• 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档

—— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 ——
• 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历
• 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间
• 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加
• 倒数日：考试、开学、放假、节日倒计时，重要日子不再靠人肉记

—— 值日安排 / 工作留痕 / 班级建设 ——
• 值日分组轮换；组内可指定岗位（如组长、扫地等），支持调整顺序与一键均分
• 今日值日一目了然，适合早读前、放学后快速核对
• 工作留痕：家访、班会、家长沟通随时记；可附照片、视频、语音，应对检查少翻聊天记录
• 班级建设：班训、班规、班委会、活动荣誉、板报照片入库，班级文化有处放

—— 学生积分（可选开启）——
• 点名加减分、规则可配
• 段位、宠物等激励方式，让日常管理更有参与感
• 适合平时表现量化、小组竞赛、课堂激励

—— 备份、导出与多端 ——
• 「我的」整包备份导出压缩包，换手机、换电脑再导入
• 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控
• 现已支持 Mac 桌面版：左侧功能栏 + 右侧工作区，宽屏办公更适合备课、改成绩、排座位、导出名单
• 与 iPhone 版能力对齐，备份可互通（按你实际导出导入使用）

—— 特别说明 ——
• 本 App 面向教师自用班务管理，不是教育局官方学籍系统，不能代替成绩证明、学籍证明
• 学生姓名、电话、身份证号、家庭信息等由你本地保管；备份文件请勿发到公开群或网盘公开链接
• 相机、相册、麦克风、通知、日历等权限仅在使用对应功能时申请，可随时在系统设置关闭
• 适合小学班主任、初中班主任、高中班主任、中职班主任，以及需要管班的任课教师、实习教师

一句话总结：把点名册、成绩表、座位表、作业名单、课表、评语、值日表、家访记录，从零散表格和微信里收进一个「班主任班级管理」工具里——本地、好用、能导出、能备份，手机和电脑都能干活。

tw.releaseNotes: 您，可曾幻想過真正主宰一個王朝的命運？這一次，您不再是旁觀者，而是化身主角，進入這部真人互動的宮廷生存影像作品！《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇——全新推出！您將掙脫命運的枷鎖，一步步走上那座象徵至高無上的龍椅。該如何書寫您的盛世天下？一切，由您親手決定！
tw.description:
本作品需全程連線。媚娘篇內容共十六集，女帝篇內容共三十二集，均含免費體驗章節。

您可能從沒體驗過這樣的作品——您當主角，真人互動的宮廷冒險！
《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇全新推出！誠摯邀請您踏上驚險刺激的東方宮廷權謀之旅。

● 承襲《媚娘篇》佳績，再續宮廷傳奇
《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》媚娘篇贏得了廣大用戶的喜愛。
新篇《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇，邀您提前鎖定這場驚心動魄的朝堂博弈，共同期待東方女帝傳奇的登頂新巔峰！

● 4K電影級質感，重塑東方宮廷美學
全程真人演繹、實景打造，結合4K電影級光影調度，匠心重現東方宮闕的恢弘氣象。從華服錦緞、金釵搖曳的細膩質感，到震撼人心的中國風配樂，全方位呈現極致東方古典美學。由官鴻、黃羿、姚弛、林小宅等知名演員傾情演出。更真實、更驚險刺激的體驗，更宏大的場景、更細膩的人物刻畫，讓盛世不再只存在於螢幕之中，而是於眼前真實展開。您將親身沉浸於「君臨天下」的東方美學盛宴！

● 從默默無聞的少女到傳奇女帝，您的劇本您來寫！
急欲掙脫命運的束縛？在本作品中，您將體驗最驚心動魄的宮廷權謀博弈！從默默無聞的少女，在多方勢力掣肘中突破困局，最終登上權力巔峰。感受運籌帷幄、制衡朝局的帝王智慧，這條逆天改命的稱帝之路，由您親手開創！

● 約1500分鐘真人演繹內容，沉浸體驗帝王人生
匠心打造的《媚娘篇》與《女帝篇》共約1500分鐘的實拍篇章，為您鋪展出一幅波瀾壯闊的盛世畫卷。面對詭譎多變的朝堂局勢，每一次落子、每一句對話，都將引發蝴蝶效應。高張力反轉、重重懸疑……在步步驚心中執掌乾坤，親手改寫王朝命運！
為您情有獨鍾或愛恨交織的角色應援助陣，誰能問鼎全球人氣榜首，皆由您一手掌控。

● 告別旁觀，真正體驗「朕即天下」
屏棄枯燥的點擊對話，深度互動玩法全面升級！權力不再只是一句空洞的台詞，而是您指尖真實運作的朝堂制衡

批閱奏摺：指尖輕點，趣解百態民生。面對層出不窮的新奇提案與市井趣事，看你如何妙筆生花、巧思破局，以奇招惠及萬民。

頒布聖旨：御筆輕懸，執掌群臣榮辱。看你如何恩威並施、論功行賞；透過封賞、發落與追貶，盡顯女帝知人善任的御人之道。

● 您是什麼類型的帝王？專屬人格測驗報告升級
在故事的終點，您還將獲得一份升級版專屬帝王測試報告！深度解析您的權謀風格、危機決策與馭人之道。究竟您是權情兼收、八面玲瓏的「絕命鶴頂紅」，還是至情至性、赴湯蹈火的「風月曼陀羅」，又或是心狠手辣、一心登頂的「卷王見手青」？在故事的最後，看見最真實的自己，並將您的專屬女帝圖鑑分享給全世界！

關於New One Studio

我們是專注於互動敘事的獨立團隊，致力於用創新手法融合東方文化與互動體驗。2019年，是一路同行的大家陪着《隱形守護者》走過 BAFTA 的榮光，更讓我們確信：好的互動敘事，能讓故事住進人心。這幾年，我們一頭栽進了古代盛世，醞釀了一個全新的故事。《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》，不僅為大家呈現東方權謀的「致命」美學，同時帶來考驗智謀與膽識的朝堂博弈。

兩個作品，不同的故事，同一顆初心，希望全球用戶都能在遊玩中再一次感受東方傳統文化的魅力，它將成為跨越文化的橋樑，為每一位支持全動態影像作品的用戶帶來一次全新體驗。

在《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》中，你將親自體驗一代女帝的成長之路。《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》之媚娘篇聚焦於她傳奇的起點——看她如何從默默無聞的少女，在危機四伏的宮廷中步步為營，憑智慧與膽識在險象環生的權力交鋒中存活下來。

在《女王的遊戲：盛世天下》女帝篇中，你將以執棋者的姿態直面更殘酷的朝堂博弈。運籌帷幄、制衡群臣，在波譎雲詭中開創盛世，親手書寫屬於你的盛世天下！

Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app.

With over 20,000 precision-cut, chord-based loops across 15 diverse Jazz Fusion styles included, the app instantly converts the chords you select into great-sounding audio - wherever you are and whatever your ability. Perfect for songwriters and producers and the ultimate play-along for jazz rock and pop instrumentalists.

Highly acclaimed, multi award-winning pianist Tom Cawley is one of the most sought-after keyboard players in the world both as a jazz pianist (Dave Weckl, Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker...), and as a leading pop/rock keyboardist, recording and performing around the world with U2, Peter Gabriel, Andrea Bocelli, Amy Winehouse and many others.

For this special Jazz Fusion edition, Tom is joined by 2 of the world's top session musicians: Simon Lea – Drums (Rod Stewart, Dionne Warwick, James Blunt, James Morrison, Katie Melua...) and Geoff Gascoyne – Bass (Sting, Van Morrison, Georgie Fame...).

Tom's passion for jazz and for modern and vintage keys is reflected in the diverse range of styles in this edition. And Tom has employed many of the best keyboards from his vast personal collection: from the Oberheim OB-6, Prophet 12 and Moog Model D (as well as a modular set-up), to his vintage Fender Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Hohner Pianet - they all feature in the content of this app. And to do full justice to this genre, we have increased the number of chord variations to 15 for every root note in all 15 styles!

Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier.

tw.description:
MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Begin a gorgeous, hand-drawn quest. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.
It is the year 5000, and the greatest achievements in human history are forgotten. The pyramids, the Mona Lisa, The Fresh Prince of Bel Air – forgotten.
Forgotten by everyone except Henry Dijon and his ragtag team of archaeologists. They left Mars to dig up lost treasures on the wild and inhospitable Planet Earth. Life is sweet, until Henry’s professor is kidnapped, and thing start to get... weird.
Join Henry on a freewheeling adventure through the ruins of our civilization. Ask questions like, “Who was this Sony Walkman? And where did he walk?” Unearth extraordinary relics, rescue Professor Totel, and be the first to enter the legendary city of Mutropolis.
One more thing - the gods of ancient Egypt are real and they’re trying to destroy humanity. - Have fun!

Features
• 50+ hand-drawn scenes, crammed with cute, weird characters.
• Full voice over in English, text localizations in Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Korean.
• Archaeological puzzles with a sci-fi twist.
• TONS OF LOVE!

tw.description:
Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

※NOTICE※
This game does not support devices running iOS 11 (including beta versions) or later. Please be aware of this when changing devices and/or updating your device's iOS as the game may not run properly under an unsupported version of iOS.

※IMPORTANT※
・Please read "Supported iOS and Devices" before purchasing or playing.

In cases where the game unexpectedly crashes:
Please try re-downloading your purchase data (Title Screen -> Purchase Content -> Restore).

If the above steps do not resolve the issue, please contact us at mobilesupport@capcom.com.

== Game Intro ==

There are no "Objections!" to this exciting entry of the Ace Attorney series! Become a lawyer and solve the case. Your client's life is in your hands!
Clear you client in Episode 1, then purchase Episodes 2 through 5 of the main story individually or as a set.

◆Point Your Way to Victory◆
Simply tap the screen to play. The intuitive interface includes useful features such as a backlog for you to re-read testimony and story dialogue.

◆Immersive Investigations◆
Freely explore 3D crime scenes for evidence and speak with witnesses for information that you can use in court.

◆Fast-Paced, Entertaining Trials◆
Dismantle lies and resolve contradictions between witnesses' words and the evidence. Solve the case and save your client from trumped-up charges!

◆Colorful Cast of Characters◆
Join Phoenix Wright and his junior lawyers as they confront an all new cast of interesting, amusing, and sometimes outrageous characters. Fan favorites also make their return under some unexpected and unusual circumstances!

◆Surprising Twists◆
Delight in solving the mysteries and smile at the characters' amusing and often ridiculous shenanigans. The drama and dialogue will keep you laughing, crying, and guessing until the very end!

◆Lighthearted Additional Content◆
Dress the three lawyer protagonists up in costumes and use them in the main game for some unintentionally humorous trials!

In addition, try your hand at the extra Special Episode "Turnabout Reclaimed"! Can you successfully defend a wrongfully accused killer killer whale and bring this aquatic punk pirate show to a happy end?

◆iCloud Support◆
Transfer your save data between multiple iOS devices to play wherever and whenever you want!

※The story in this game is the same as in previous releases.


*When Purchasing Content*
・Episodes 2 through 5 can be purchased separately or together as a pack (Main Story Set). In the event that the content of your purchases overlap, please be aware that we cannot refund you the difference.


*Supported iOS and Devices*

SLOTS & DAGGERS is a roguelike in a slot machine.

Spin the reels, chain symbols into combos, and turn every pull into damage, gold and upgrades. Build your machine run by run, then take it into the dungeon and fight your way through a weird little fantasy world full of goblins, monsters and strange little guys.
Every spin matters. Every symbol you add changes the odds. And every run ends with the same question: one more?

FEATURES
- A slot machine that fights back – build synergies, break the reels, beat the odds
- A weird fantasy world drawn by hand, in all its crude glory
- 4–8 hour campaign with escalating challenges
- Egg Arena – an endless high-score mode for the truly determined
- Retro visuals with a hand-drawn, lo-fi charm
- Crunchy old-school hip hop drum machine soundtrack
- Quick runs, deep builds – perfect for a session on the go
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no real money involved – just the game

Numbers! Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING.

----

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS.
To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.
As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal!
I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,
Friedemann

自2006年首次亮相以來，《泰坦之旅》吸引了眾多玩家。在《泰坦之旅》世界中，你將在無拘無束的英雄之旅中獲得全方位的體驗！

你的光榮任務是拯救世界！

單靠諸神無法打敗泰坦，所以需要真正的英雄 - 那就是你！你的成功或失敗將決定人類和奧林匹斯山諸神的命運！與你的定制英雄一起，探索希臘、埃及、巴比倫和中國的神秘、遠古世界。征服成群的傳奇生物，掌握各種武器和武術：射箭、劍術或使用強大的魔法！

遊歷古代和北歐神話世界！

當你旅行前往派特農神廟、大金字塔、巴比倫空中花園、長城、塔耳塔洛斯競技場和其他著名景點時，與神話中的野獸戰鬥。遭遇希臘神話中的最大惡棍，探索北歐未知的土地，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國，然後踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程。

在你的光榮道路上，要麼全部得到，要麼一無所有！

每一個挑戰等待著你，你必須擊敗更大更強的敵人，直到達到目標並迫使泰坦屈服！與勇敢的寵物同伴一起投入戰鬥！尋找具有特殊力量的非凡物品，這些物品將增強你的能力，幫助你前進。傳奇之劍、強大的閃電咒語、魔法、弓箭以及力量超乎想像的無數其他寶藏等待著你 - 它們全都可以在你的戰鬥中使用，在可怕的生物中散佈驚駭和恐懼！

你在等什麼？

不同於其他動作角色扮演遊戲，《泰坦之旅：傳奇版》將迷人的神話世界與無盡而刺激的動作融合在一起，正如你對如此引人入勝的遊戲所期待的！

主要特點：

- 在不朽王座下載包的世界中，你將遇到希臘神話中的最大惡棍，勇敢面對地獄犬的攻擊，危害冥河的河岸。你需要解釋盲人提爾西亞斯的預言，與阿伽門農和阿喀琉斯並肩作戰，用奧德修斯的計策征服這個黑暗的新冒險。

- 在諸神黃昏下載包的北歐未知土地上，你將勇敢面對凱爾特人、諾斯曼人和阿斯加迪神靈的領地！

- 在亞特蘭蒂斯下載包，與探險家會面，尋找神話中的亞特蘭蒂斯王國。據說有一把鑰匙藏在伊拉克利翁的日記中，該日記據傳位於腓尼基城市加迪爾。踏上穿越地中海西部的旅程，包括塔耳塔洛斯競技場，進行史詩般的戰鬥！

+ 經過全面技術修改的《泰坦之旅》實施了所有的重要更新，以賦予這部經典之作最佳的遊戲體驗！

在永恆餘燼DLC可在應用內購買的 中殺死巨巫泰肯之後，英雄受到傳說中的堯帝召喚，回到東方著手對付一直肆虐 這片大陸的邪魔威脅。 在追查過程中，英雄和他的同伴們發現，遠古兇獸窮奇的現身並非只是巧合，必定有兇險萬分的陰謀正在醞釀…

《身為警察》（This Is the Police）是一個策略/冒險遊戲，故事背景設定在一個螺旋式圍繞排水系統的城市。在遊戲中你將擔任堅韌不拔的警察局長傑克·博伊德的角色，你將潛入一個關於犯罪和陰謀的深刻故事。傑克會不會拿到一大筆錢安心地退休，亦或是最終會破產...還是更糟？

 - 你的任務很明確：在傑克·博伊德退休之前的180天內賺到50萬美元。怎麼賺？一切由你決定！

 - 決定，決定！《身為警察》（This Is the Police）的故事核心是一個黑暗的故事，以及你該如何破解它。無論你決定什麼，你的選擇都會影響比賽 - 以及傑克博伊德的命運。

- 《黃昏三鏢客》？弗里堡警察局局長能夠應付各種人。遊戲全看你的本事，找到壞人並決定如何處理他們。

 - 履行你的職責。作為弗里堡警察局的負責人，傑克每天都要處理各種各樣的挑戰：應對緊急情況，管理他的警員，保衛部門對抗市政廳和腐敗的市長等等。

 - 執行調查並收集針對弗里堡犯罪團伙的證據。

 - 處理城市中的競爭力量。每個人都可向你提供服務，但每一個都是有代價的。

 - 豐富而完整的配音故事：由《毀滅公爵》的配音演員Jon St. John為傑克·博伊德配音。

us.description:
当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。

谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。

「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。

班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。

—— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 ——
• 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理
• 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型）
• 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理
• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用
• 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快

—— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 ——
• 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录
• 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室
• 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯
• 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考

—— 作业反馈 / 收作业 ——
• 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀
• 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」
• 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享
• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

—— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 ——
• 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生
• 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看
• Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表
• 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦

—— 课程表 / 调课助手 ——
• 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表
• 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表
• 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习
• 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周
• 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出
• 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案

—— 座位表 / 智能排座 ——
• 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座
• 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着）
• 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖
• 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向）
• 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴

—— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 ——
• 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到
• 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库
• 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档

—— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 ——
• 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历
• 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间
• 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加
• 倒数日：考试、开学、放假、节日倒计时，重要日子不再靠人肉记

—— 值日安排 / 工作留痕 / 班级建设 ——
• 值日分组轮换；组内可指定岗位（如组长、扫地等），支持调整顺序与一键均分
• 今日值日一目了然，适合早读前、放学后快速核对
• 工作留痕：家访、班会、家长沟通随时记；可附照片、视频、语音，应对检查少翻聊天记录
• 班级建设：班训、班规、班委会、活动荣誉、板报照片入库，班级文化有处放

—— 学生积分（可选开启）——
• 点名加减分、规则可配
• 段位、宠物等激励方式，让日常管理更有参与感
• 适合平时表现量化、小组竞赛、课堂激励

—— 备份、导出与多端 ——
• 「我的」整包备份导出压缩包，换手机、换电脑再导入
• 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控
• 现已支持 Mac 桌面版：左侧功能栏 + 右侧工作区，宽屏办公更适合备课、改成绩、排座位、导出名单
• 与 iPhone 版能力对齐，备份可互通（按你实际导出导入使用）

—— 特别说明 ——
• 本 App 面向教师自用班务管理，不是教育局官方学籍系统，不能代替成绩证明、学籍证明
• 学生姓名、电话、身份证号、家庭信息等由你本地保管；备份文件请勿发到公开群或网盘公开链接
• 相机、相册、麦克风、通知、日历等权限仅在使用对应功能时申请，可随时在系统设置关闭
• 适合小学班主任、初中班主任、高中班主任、中职班主任，以及需要管班的任课教师、实习教师

一句话总结：把点名册、成绩表、座位表、作业名单、课表、评语、值日表、家访记录，从零散表格和微信里收进一个「班主任班级管理」工具里——本地、好用、能导出、能备份，手机和电脑都能干活。

us.description:
MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Begin a gorgeous, hand-drawn quest. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.
It is the year 5000, and the greatest achievements in human history are forgotten. The pyramids, the Mona Lisa, The Fresh Prince of Bel Air – forgotten.
Forgotten by everyone except Henry Dijon and his ragtag team of archaeologists. They left Mars to dig up lost treasures on the wild and inhospitable Planet Earth. Life is sweet, until Henry’s professor is kidnapped, and thing start to get... weird.
Join Henry on a freewheeling adventure through the ruins of our civilization. Ask questions like, “Who was this Sony Walkman? And where did he walk?” Unearth extraordinary relics, rescue Professor Totel, and be the first to enter the legendary city of Mutropolis.
One more thing - the gods of ancient Egypt are real and they’re trying to destroy humanity. - Have fun!

Features
• 50+ hand-drawn scenes, crammed with cute, weird characters.
• Full voice over in English, text localizations in Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Korean.
• Archaeological puzzles with a sci-fi twist.
• TONS OF LOVE!

SessionBand Jazz Fusion – Tom Cawley Special Synth & Vintage Keys Edition

Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app.

With over 20,000 precision-cut, chord-based loops across 15 diverse Jazz Fusion styles included, the app instantly converts the chords you select into great-sounding audio - wherever you are and whatever your ability. Perfect for songwriters and producers and the ultimate play-along for jazz rock and pop instrumentalists.

Highly acclaimed, multi award-winning pianist Tom Cawley is one of the most sought-after keyboard players in the world both as a jazz pianist (Dave Weckl, Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker...), and as a leading pop/rock keyboardist, recording and performing around the world with U2, Peter Gabriel, Andrea Bocelli, Amy Winehouse and many others.

For this special Jazz Fusion edition, Tom is joined by 2 of the world's top session musicians: Simon Lea – Drums (Rod Stewart, Dionne Warwick, James Blunt, James Morrison, Katie Melua...) and Geoff Gascoyne – Bass (Sting, Van Morrison, Georgie Fame...).

Tom's passion for jazz and for modern and vintage keys is reflected in the diverse range of styles in this edition. And Tom has employed many of the best keyboards from his vast personal collection: from the Oberheim OB-6, Prophet 12 and Moog Model D (as well as a modular set-up), to his vintage Fender Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Hohner Pianet - they all feature in the content of this app. And to do full justice to this genre, we have increased the number of chord variations to 15 for every root note in all 15 styles!

Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier.

That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...

us.description:
Digline is a relaxed and easy to learn drilling game where every descent is a gamble between progress and risk, and the real reward lies deeper underground.

Start each run in your workshop, pick your setup, and head down with limited fuel and a scrappy rig. Carve your path through shifting layers of earth, decide what to collect, and choose what to upgrade and what to trade before everything runs out.

Each dive reveals new materials, rarer finds, and unexpected patterns beneath the surface. What begins as simple digging gradually turns into a careful balance between exploration, efficiency, and timing.

Back at the surface, refine your strategy and improve your runs:

• Upgrade your drill, fuel capacity, and efficiency
• Unlock new materials with higher value and deeper placement
• Optimize routes to maximize each descent

Progress builds steadily, but every run carries tension. Go too safe and you leave value behind. Push too far and risk losing it all.

Shape your own rhythm underground: short and efficient runs, deep high-risk dives, or a steady climb toward mastering what lies below.

Top 10 casual game in the US and UK, Top 5 in Germany, Norway, and others. Come join the fun!

What starts as a simple search for resources gradually becomes something stranger. Your old tunnels remain, your map expands over time, and the underground begins to feel less random and more like a place with its own history.

Digline is designed to be easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, and rewarding over the long term. Quick digs, short descents, tons of relaxing fun.

Features:

• intuitive one-finger portrait controls
• short runs that fit easily into a minute or two
• persistent tunnels and a map that grows with each expedition
• multiple underground regions with different materials, hazards, and surprises
• resources to gather and use for crafting upgrades, and better preparation
• a workshop that turns each successful run into permanent progress
• a market system for trading what you bring back
• progression that builds across many sessions, not just a single run
• a calm, cozy atmosphere with a sense of discovery underneath it
• no ads, no in-app purchases, and no pay-to-win systems
• achievements and Daily Dig leaderboard competition

The deeper you go, the more the mine will reveal.

us.description:
SLOTS & DAGGERS is a roguelike in a slot machine.

Spin the reels, chain symbols into combos, and turn every pull into damage, gold and upgrades. Build your machine run by run, then take it into the dungeon and fight your way through a weird little fantasy world full of goblins, monsters and strange little guys.
Every spin matters. Every symbol you add changes the odds. And every run ends with the same question: one more?

FEATURES
- A slot machine that fights back – build synergies, break the reels, beat the odds
- A weird fantasy world drawn by hand, in all its crude glory
- 4–8 hour campaign with escalating challenges
- Egg Arena – an endless high-score mode for the truly determined
- Retro visuals with a hand-drawn, lo-fi charm
- Crunchy old-school hip hop drum machine soundtrack
- Quick runs, deep builds – perfect for a session on the go
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no real money involved – just the game

Numbers! Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING.

----

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS.
To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.
As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal!
I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,
Friedemann

tr.description:
当班主任之后才发现：真正耗人的不是上课，是记事。

谁请假、谁迟到、谁缺勤、谁没交作业、这场考试均分多少、分数段怎么分布、座位要不要再调、期末评语从哪写起、值日谁扫地谁当组长、调课通知怎么发给家长——Excel 表格开了又开，微信聊天翻了又翻，备忘录、班级群、纸质点名册来回切换。

「我不想当班主任」是专为班主任、副班主任、年级组长、任课老师设计的本地班级管理工具 / 班务助手 / 班级事务管理 App。不用注册、不用登录、不建账号；学生档案、考勤记录、作业反馈、成绩管理、课程表、调课助手、座位表、在校表现、评语管理、错题本、待办提醒、倒数日、值日安排、工作留痕、班级建设、学生积分等，默认都只保存在你自己的手机或电脑里，隐私更安心。支持多班级切换，一个 App 管多个班。

班级管理、学生管理、班主任工具、班务工作台、智慧班级、电子点名、课堂考勤、请假登记、作业检查、未交作业名单、优秀作业、订正作业、成绩录入、学情分析、均分统计、分数段、班级排名、课程表、个人课表、班级课表、调课代课、座位编排、排座位、评语库、学生评语、错题本、错题拍照、待办事项、教师待办、倒数日、考试倒计时、值日生、值日表、家访记录、班会记录、班级文化、班训班规、学生积分、加减分、本地存储、无网络也可用、Excel 导入导出、数据备份换机。

—— 学生档案 / 学生花名册 ——
• 姓名、学号、性别、民族、生日、电话、家庭住址、家庭情况、监护人信息按班级分开管理
• 监护人类型可自定义（父亲、母亲、祖父、祖母，也可自建类型）
• 支持 Excel、CSV 批量导入导出，表头识别更宽松，适合从学校下发的花名册、学籍表整理
• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用
• 学生名单、关联学生默认按学号大小排序，查找更快

—— 考勤管理 / 电子点名 ——
• 迟到、请假、缺勤、早退等异常当场记录
• 可切换「座位图点名」或「列表点名」，贴近真实教室
• 考勤类型可在设置里增删配置，适配各校习惯
• 考勤数据可进入学情、评语、表现等后续参考

—— 作业反馈 / 收作业 ——
• 布置作业后快速点未交、已交、迟交、订正、优秀
• 支持导出「未交名单」「优秀名单」「订正名单」
• 名单可复制文字发班级群 / 家长群，也可生成图片分享
• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

—— 成绩管理 / 学情分析 ——
• 录入各科考试成绩，查看均分、走势、分数段、需关注学生
• 支持科目筛选、班级排名相关查看
• Excel 导入导出，对接学校常用成绩表
• 自定义科目名称更稳，减少「科目对不上」的麻烦

—— 课程表 / 调课助手 ——
• 支持多套课表：班级课表、个人课表、自定义课表
• 可新建、重命名、删除、一键切换课表
• 节次时间可改，节次与课程格子支持自定义颜色，一眼区分语数外、早晚自习
• 同一节可排单周 / 双周；设置开学日与大小周
• 右上角表格支持课表 Excel 导入导出
• 调课助手：对调、代课、挪课、停课，一键生成发给家长的调课通知文案

—— 座位表 / 智能排座 ——
• 按学号、男女间隔、成绩等规则一键排座
• 可设置避开相邻（前后左右尽量不挨着）
• 支持整体平移：整列左移右移、整排前移后移，调座位不用一个个拖
• 教师视角 / 学生视角切换（学生视角更符合孩子看讲台的方向）
• 座位方案可导出，方便打印张贴

—— 在校表现 / 评语 / 错题本 ——
• 表扬、进步、纪律等表现记入档案，排座和写评语都能用到
• 评语管理：内置大量基础评语，可按成绩、考勤、表现组合；支持 Excel 维护评语库
• 错题本：拍照入库，本地识字整理题目；待订正 / 已掌握分开看；可按科目、按学生归档

—— 待办提醒 / 倒数日 ——
• 批改、收作业、家访、开会设好时间，到点提醒；可写入系统日历
• 支持语音输入待办，口语说时间也能识别；没说截止时间时自动给默认时间
• 待办快捷按钮可配置，常用事项一键添加
• 倒数日：考试、开学、放假、节日倒计时，重要日子不再靠人肉记

—— 值日安排 / 工作留痕 / 班级建设 ——
• 值日分组轮换；组内可指定岗位（如组长、扫地等），支持调整顺序与一键均分
• 今日值日一目了然，适合早读前、放学后快速核对
• 工作留痕：家访、班会、家长沟通随时记；可附照片、视频、语音，应对检查少翻聊天记录
• 班级建设：班训、班规、班委会、活动荣誉、板报照片入库，班级文化有处放

—— 学生积分（可选开启）——
• 点名加减分、规则可配
• 段位、宠物等激励方式，让日常管理更有参与感
• 适合平时表现量化、小组竞赛、课堂激励

—— 备份、导出与多端 ——
• 「我的」整包备份导出压缩包，换手机、换电脑再导入
• 解压后可用表格软件查看，关键数据自己掌控
• 现已支持 Mac 桌面版：左侧功能栏 + 右侧工作区，宽屏办公更适合备课、改成绩、排座位、导出名单
• 与 iPhone 版能力对齐，备份可互通（按你实际导出导入使用）

—— 特别说明 ——
• 本 App 面向教师自用班务管理，不是教育局官方学籍系统，不能代替成绩证明、学籍证明
• 学生姓名、电话、身份证号、家庭信息等由你本地保管；备份文件请勿发到公开群或网盘公开链接
• 相机、相册、麦克风、通知、日历等权限仅在使用对应功能时申请，可随时在系统设置关闭
• 适合小学班主任、初中班主任、高中班主任、中职班主任，以及需要管班的任课教师、实习教师

一句话总结：把点名册、成绩表、座位表、作业名单、课表、评语、值日表、家访记录，从零散表格和微信里收进一个「班主任班级管理」工具里——本地、好用、能导出、能备份，手机和电脑都能干活。

SessionBand Jazz Fusion – Tom Cawley Special Synth & Vintage Keys Edition

Create studio-quality Jazz Fusion tracks to your own chords in minutes with this special artist edition of the award-winning SessionBand app - the world’s only chord-based loop app.

With over 20,000 precision-cut, chord-based loops across 15 diverse Jazz Fusion styles included, the app instantly converts the chords you select into great-sounding audio - wherever you are and whatever your ability. Perfect for songwriters and producers and the ultimate play-along for jazz rock and pop instrumentalists.

Highly acclaimed, multi award-winning pianist Tom Cawley is one of the most sought-after keyboard players in the world both as a jazz pianist (Dave Weckl, Jack DeJohnette, Charlie Watts, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker...), and as a leading pop/rock keyboardist, recording and performing around the world with U2, Peter Gabriel, Andrea Bocelli, Amy Winehouse and many others.

For this special Jazz Fusion edition, Tom is joined by 2 of the world's top session musicians: Simon Lea – Drums (Rod Stewart, Dionne Warwick, James Blunt, James Morrison, Katie Melua...) and Geoff Gascoyne – Bass (Sting, Van Morrison, Georgie Fame...).

Tom's passion for jazz and for modern and vintage keys is reflected in the diverse range of styles in this edition. And Tom has employed many of the best keyboards from his vast personal collection: from the Oberheim OB-6, Prophet 12 and Moog Model D (as well as a modular set-up), to his vintage Fender Rhodes, Wurlitzer and Hohner Pianet - they all feature in the content of this app. And to do full justice to this genre, we have increased the number of chord variations to 15 for every root note in all 15 styles!

Alongside pro features like automated mixing, auto-transpose, one-touch live recording and a range of export functions, there are new tech features and upgrades like channel FX, instant PDF chord sheets and 'Track Builder' to make your track creation quicker and easier.

Create professional Jazz Fusion to your own choice of chords in minutes. Everything you need to create and share thousands of stunning royalty-free tracks.

• Instantly hear your track across different styles and tempos
• Auto-transpose your entire track
• Add FX

tr.description:
MUTROPOLIS is a lovely sci-fi adventure set on the abandoned Planet Earth. Play as Henry Dijon (hero, nerd, detective) in search of a legendary lost city. Begin a gorgeous, hand-drawn quest. Uncover weird ancient artifacts. And PLEASE don’t get obliterated by an ageless evil. You’ve been warned.
It is the year 5000, and the greatest achievements in human history are forgotten. The pyramids, the Mona Lisa, The Fresh Prince of Bel Air – forgotten.
Forgotten by everyone except Henry Dijon and his ragtag team of archaeologists. They left Mars to dig up lost treasures on the wild and inhospitable Planet Earth. Life is sweet, until Henry’s professor is kidnapped, and thing start to get... weird.
Join Henry on a freewheeling adventure through the ruins of our civilization. Ask questions like, “Who was this Sony Walkman? And where did he walk?” Unearth extraordinary relics, rescue Professor Totel, and be the first to enter the legendary city of Mutropolis.
One more thing - the gods of ancient Egypt are real and they’re trying to destroy humanity. - Have fun!

Features
• 50+ hand-drawn scenes, crammed with cute, weird characters.
• Full voice over in English, text localizations in Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian and Korean.
• Archaeological puzzles with a sci-fi twist.

Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

tr.description:
SLOTS & DAGGERS is a roguelike in a slot machine.

Spin the reels, chain symbols into combos, and turn every pull into damage, gold and upgrades. Build your machine run by run, then take it into the dungeon and fight your way through a weird little fantasy world full of goblins, monsters and strange little guys.
Every spin matters. Every symbol you add changes the odds. And every run ends with the same question: one more?

FEATURES
- A slot machine that fights back – build synergies, break the reels, beat the odds
- A weird fantasy world drawn by hand, in all its crude glory
- 4–8 hour campaign with escalating challenges
- Egg Arena – an endless high-score mode for the truly determined
- Retro visuals with a hand-drawn, lo-fi charm
- Crunchy old-school hip hop drum machine soundtrack
- Quick runs, deep builds – perfect for a session on the go
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no real money involved – just the game

Numbers! Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING.

----

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS.
To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.
As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal!
I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,
Friedemann

Titan Quest has captivated legions of players since its 2006 debut. You get the all-encompassing experience of an unbridled, truly heroic journey through the worlds of Titan Quest!

Your honorable quest is to save the world!

The gods alone cannot defeat the Titans, so real heroes are needed - and that can only be you! Your success or failure will decide the fate of the people and the Olympians! With your custom-created hero, scour the mystical and ancient worlds of Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China. Conquer the hordes of legendary creatures and master various weapons and martial arts: Archery, sword fighting, or the use of powerful magic!

Travel a world of antiquity and Nordic mythology!

Battle the beasts of mythology as you travel to the Parthenon, the Great Pyramids, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, the Great Wall, the Tartarus Arena, and other famous places. Encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, discover the uncharted lands of northern Europe, search for the mythical kingdom of Atlantis, and set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean.

It’s all or nothing on your glorious path!

With each challenge that awaits you, you'll have to defeat bigger and stronger enemies until you reach your goal and force the Titans to their knees! Rush into battle alongside brave pet companions! Find extraordinary items with special powers that will enhance your abilities and help you on your path. Legendary swords, powerful lightning spells, magical, bows and numerous other treasures with unimaginable powers await you - all of them are at your disposal in your battles and spread fear and terror among the hideous creatures!

What are you waiting for?

Like no other game in the Action RPG genre, Titan Quest: Legendary Edition combines the fascinating world of mythology with endless and exciting action that you would expect from such a compelling game!

Features:
+ Within the world of the Immortal Throne DLC, you’ll encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, brave the attacks of Cerberus, and hazard the banks of the River Styx. You have to interpret the prophecies of the blind seer Tiresias, fight alongside Agamemnon and Achilles, and use the wiles of Odysseus to conquer this dark new adventure.

+ In the uncharted lands of northern Europe in the Ragnarök DLC, you’ll brave the realms of the Celts, the Northmen, and the Asgardian gods!

+ Meet an explorer in the Atlantis DLC, in search of the mythical kingdom of Atlantis. A key is supposedly hidden in the diary of Herakles, which is rumored to be located in the Phoenician City of Gadir. Set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean, including the Tartarus Arena for epic battles!

+ All important updates have been implemented to the technically overhauled Titan Quest to grant the best gaming experience of this classic ever!

+ ETERNAL EMBERS DLCs available as in-app purchase - Summoned by the legendary Emperor Yao, the Hero is called back into the East to deal with a demonic threat that has been ravaging the land after the Telkine was slain.

! A note for all players who own the base version of Titan Quest: The DLCs mentioned here are also available for purchase as additional content so that all fans can upgrade their game to fully enjoy all expansions!

Dive into a deep story of corruption, crime and intrigue. Take the role of gritty Police Chief Jack Boyd, and come face to face with the ugly underbelly of Freeburg, a city spiraling the drain. Will Jack reach his retirement with a nice stack of bills, or will he end up broken ... or worse? 

Manage your staff, respond to emergencies, and investigate crimes in a city on the brink of chaos. The mafia underworld maneuvers behind the scenes, sinking their claws ever deeper into the city, even as the mayor is ready to exploit every situation to his political advantage. 

Choose your approach to each situation as it unfolds. Sometimes you’ll be responding to a developing crisis at a crime scene, or negotiating with Freeburg’s crime bosses. Sometimes you’ll find yourself dodging questions in the press room, or even the occasional cross-examination in the witness box. Can you keep this pressure cooker from exploding, at least for long enough to stash away a nice retirement nest egg?

- Your mission is clear: make $500,000 in 180 days before Jack Boyd reaches retirement. How? That’s up to you!

- Decisions, decisions! This Is the Police is all about a dark story and how you react to it. Whatever you decide, your choices will influence the game – and the fate of Jack Boyd.

- The Good, the Bad, and... the Ugly? The Chief of Freeburg's Police Department deals with all kind of people. It is up to you to find the bad guys and decide how to deal with them.

- Carry out your duties. As head of Freeburg PD, Jack deals with all sorts of challenges every day: responding to emergencies, managing his officers, defending the department against City Hall and a corrupt mayor, and much more.

- Solve Investigations and gather evidence against the criminal gangs of Freeburg.

- Deal with the competing powers of the city. Everyone offers you favors, and each one comes at a price.
Rich and fully voiced story: Jack Boyd is portrayed by Jon St. John, the voice of Duke Nukem.

• 单个学生可导出 PDF、Word 或图片，方便家访、约谈、材料存档
• 住宿信息选填：就餐、晚托、上下学方式等，寄宿班、走读班都能用

• 支持扫码登记：已交、订正、优秀，课堂收本更高效

MUTROPOLIS é uma adorável aventura sci-fi que se passa em um Planeta Terra abandonado. Jogue como Henry Dijon (herói, nerd, detetive) em busca de uma lendária cidade perdida. Inicie uma bela jornada desenhada à mão e descubra estranhos artefatos antigos. E POR FAVOR, não seja obliterado por um perpétuo mal. Você foi avisado.
É o ano 5000 e as maiores conquistas da humanidade foram perdidas. As pirâmides, a Mona Lisa e Um Maluco no Pedaço foram totalmente esquecidos.
Esquecidos por todos exceto Henry Dijon e sua maluca equipe de arqueológos. Eles saíram de Marte para escavar tesouros perdidos no selvagem e inabitável Planeta Terra. Tudo corre bem até o professor de Henry ser raptado e as coisas começarem a ficar… esquisitas.
Junte-se a Henry em uma aventura através das ruínas de nossa civilização. Faça perguntas como "Quem foi Sony Walkman? Por onde ele andava?" Descubra relíquias extraordinárias, resgate o Professor Totel e seja o primeiro a entrar na lendária cidade de Mutropolis.
Mais uma coisa - os deuses do antigo Egito são reais e estão tentando destruir a humanidade. - Divirta-se!

Características
• 50+ cenas desenhadas à mão repletas de personagens esquisitos e adoráveis.
• Dublagem completa em inglês e textos em espanhol, alemão, francês, italiano, português, russo e coreano.
• Puzzles arqueológicos com uma pegada sci-fi.
• MUITO AMOR!

Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.

  agrupa por loja, ordena por corredor. Partilha com pessoas do agregado familiar — qualquer alteração sincroniza em
  tempo real.

  OFERTAS DA COMUNIDADE
  Os melhores preços não estão num folheto qualquer — estão a ser observados, neste momento, por quem está em loja. Comprato é o sítio onde essas observações se juntam. Vê o que outros utilizadores apanharam recentemente nos supermercados e nos pequenos comércios locais. Filtra por categoria, loja, distrito, ou data. Inclui filtro Vegano que cruza todas as categorias.

  DESPENSA — O QUE TENS EM CASA
  A app guarda o que já tens em stock e usa essa lista para te mostrar receitas que podes cozinhar sem ir ao
  supermercado. As validades aproximam-se? A despensa avisa-te antes de estragar. Ao marcares um item da lista como
  comprado, vai direto para a despensa com data de validade sugerida pela categoria.

  COMO É QUE ISTO FUNCIONA NA PRÁTICA
  • Adicionas leite, arroz e detergente à lista.
  • A app mostra-te os preços que a comunidade viu nestes produtos nas últimas semanas, por loja.
  • Se vires uma boa oferta no terreno, partilhas em 10 segundos. Outros utilizadores validam.
  • Recebes notificação quando alguém partilha uma oferta numa marca que andas a seguir.

  MAIS FUNCIONALIDADES
  • Alertas de preço: define um valor-alvo e a app avisa quando uma marca chega a esse preço.
  • Receitas com cálculo de custo automático, baseado nos preços actuais da tua área.
  • Importa receitas a partir de qualquer site ou de uma fotografia — a app extrai ingredientes, passos e medidas
  automaticamente.
  • Modo de cozinhar mãos-livres: passos grandes, ecrã sempre ligado, ideal para o tablet em cima da bancada.
  • Planeamento de refeições semanal, com lista de compras gerada à medida e orçamento configurável.
  • Filtros alimentares (vegano, sem glúten, etc.) — vê só ofertas e receitas adequadas a quem cozinha em casa.
  • Cashback de fidelização: regista os teus cartões Continente/Pingo Doce e a app integra o desconto no custo total
  mostrado.
  • Mapa de lojas próximas, incluindo o mercado de bairro e o pequeno comércio local.
  • Mini-comércio: pequenas lojas locais podem listar os seus produtos gratuitamente, dando visibilidade fora das
  grandes superfícies.

  COMPRATO PLUS — €1,99 / ano
  3 meses gratuitos para experimentar. Plus desbloqueia planeamento de refeições ilimitado, receitas personalizadas
  baseadas no histórico, temas premium e acesso antecipado a novas funcionalidades. A versão gratuita continua a cobrir
  o essencial: lista de compras, ofertas da comunidade, alertas de preço e receitas básicas.

  PRIVACIDADE
  Não vendemos dados a terceiros. A localização só é usada se autorizares, para te mostrar as lojas mais próximas, e
  podes desligá-la a qualquer momento. Tens controlo total: exportas ou apagas a tua conta sempre que quiseres, sem ter
  que mandar email.

  100% PORTUGUÊS
  App desenhada em Portugal, em português europeu, para a realidade dos supermercados portugueses. Sem traduções
  automáticas, sem produtos brasileiros, sem moedas estrangeiras. Os utilizadores que partilham ofertas são pessoas que
  vivem cá e fazem compras como tu.

== Game Intro ==

There are no "Objections!" to this exciting entry of the Ace Attorney series! Become a lawyer and solve the case. Your client's life is in your hands!
Clear you client in Episode 1, then purchase Episodes 2 through 5 of the main story individually or as a set.

◆Point Your Way to Victory◆
Simply tap the screen to play. The intuitive interface includes useful features such as a backlog for you to re-read testimony and story dialogue.

◆Immersive Investigations◆
Freely explore 3D crime scenes for evidence and speak with witnesses for information that you can use in court.

◆Fast-Paced, Entertaining Trials◆
Dismantle lies and resolve contradictions between witnesses' words and the evidence. Solve the case and save your client from trumped-up charges!

◆Colorful Cast of Characters◆
Join Phoenix Wright and his junior lawyers as they confront an all new cast of interesting, amusing, and sometimes outrageous characters. Fan favorites also make their return under some unexpected and unusual circumstances!

◆Surprising Twists◆
Delight in solving the mysteries and smile at the characters' amusing and often ridiculous shenanigans. The drama and dialogue will keep you laughing, crying, and guessing until the very end!

◆Lighthearted Additional Content◆
Dress the three lawyer protagonists up in costumes and use them in the main game for some unintentionally humorous trials!

In addition, try your hand at the extra Special Episode "Turnabout Reclaimed"! Can you successfully defend a wrongfully accused killer killer whale and bring this aquatic punk pirate show to a happy end?

◆iCloud Support◆
Transfer your save data between multiple iOS devices to play wherever and whenever you want!

pt.description:
SLOTS & DAGGERS é um roguelike dentro de um caça-níqueis.

Gire os rolos, encadeie símbolos em combos e transforme cada puxada em dano, ouro e upgrades. Construa sua máquina partida após partida, depois leve para a masmorra e lute para atravessar um mundo esquisito de fantasia cheio de goblins, monstros e carinhas estranhos.
Cada giro importa. Cada símbolo que você adiciona muda as chances. E cada partida termina com a mesma pergunta: mais uma?

RECURSOS
- Um caça-níqueis que revida - crie sinergias, quebre os rolos, vença as chances
- Um mundo esquisito de fantasia desenhado à mão, em toda sua glória tosca
- Campanha de 4 a 8 horas com desafios crescentes
- Arena do Ovo - um modo de recorde infinito para os bem determinados
- Visuais retrô com charme lo-fi feito à mão
- Trilha sonora crocante de bateria eletrônica de hip hop old school
- Partidas rápidas, builds profundas - perfeito para uma sessão rápida
- Sem anúncios, sem compras no aplicativo, sem dinheiro real envolvido - só o jogo

Números! Lutas! Goblins! E muito PLIM.

----

UM RECADO DO DESENVOLVEDOR

Depois do meu último jogo, SUMMERHOUSE, eu queria fazer algo radicalmente diferente. Ainda pequeno, só que mais rápido, com números, lutas e goblins! O resultado é SLOTS & DAGGERS.
Para fazer este jogo, combinei uma porção de coisas que amo demais - mundos esquisitos de fantasia, desenhos brutos de carinhas estranhos, bateria eletrônica suja de hip hop da velha guarda e jogos de arcade viciantes que fazem "PLIM PLIM PLIM" quando cospem moedinhas - com mecânicas clássicas de roguelike.
Como em SUMMERHOUSE, tenha em mente que este jogo é um projeto solo, pequeno, focado e feito com cuidado. A intenção é ser curto e legal, e ele não tem o tanto de conteúdo de jogos feitos por equipes maiores ao longo de anos, mas acho que é bem justo!
Tomara que você se divirta com SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Abraços,
Friedemann

pt.description:
::: O que é o Triple A HD? :::

- O Triple A é uma aplicação de visualização inovadora e interactiva que combina o melhor de cinco outras aplicações de arte digital também criadas pela SungLab: Art Wave, Art Particle, Art Gravity, Art Linear e Art Lightning. Proporciona uma experiência única para quem procura meditação concentrada, pensamento criativo, relaxamento ou mesmo um brinquedo digital divertido para crianças e animais de estimação.

- O Triple A foi concebido para indivíduos que desejam uma experiência estética de apreciação de arte dos novos media e é adequado para todas as idades, oferecendo uma pausa relaxante e agradável para todos.

- Com faixas de música incorporadas, a Triple A incentiva o relaxamento e o alívio do stress, o que a torna uma excelente escolha para pessoas que sofrem de esgotamento, distúrbios do sono, TDAH ou que simplesmente procuram actividades calmantes.

- A aplicação inclui 5 modos de arte, cada um com 6 efeitos únicos, resultando num total de 25 efeitos hipnotizantes. 

- Para além dos 25 efeitos principais, o Triple A possui inúmeras outras características cativantes que evocam imagens de vórtices, flores e folhas, borboletas, arco-íris e muito mais.

- Experimente a espantosa explosão de 100.000 partículas directamente no seu dispositivo móvel!

Triple A combina o poder dos visualizadores interactivos com os benefícios da meditação concentrada e do pensamento criativo para proporcionar uma experiência envolvente, relaxante e agradável para utilizadores de todas as idades.

::: Características :::

- Utiliza a funcionalidade multi-toque com 5 dedos e 2 mãos
- Oferece 10 selecções de música de Aden (com a opção de ligar/desligar a música)
- Inclui 5 modos de arte distintos (Art Particle, Art Wave, Art Gravity, Art Linear, Art Lightning)
- Atinge a velocidade mais rápida (60 FPS), emitindo 100.000 partículas
- Permite a personalização do comprimento, quantidade e tamanho das partículas

::: Diferenças na versão HD ::::

- Experiência sem anúncios

pt.description:
Um roguelite de caça-níqueis que mais parece um pesadelo. Prepare-se para apostar tudo neste simulador de dívidas infinito!

CloverPit que prende os jogadores num inferno que eles mesmos criaram. Trancado numa cela caindo aos pedaços com uma máquina caça-níqueis e um caixa eletrônico, você precisa pagar sua dívida no fim de cada rodada ou, literalmente, desmoronar.

Manipule a máquina caça-níqueis para ganhar moedas extras e faça o possível para se dar bem com vários prêmios e amuletos que desencadeiam combos gigantescos e ainda se acumulam, resultando numa partida de sucesso. Quebre as regras, leve vantagem e pague seu sequestrador pelo máximo de tempo que conseguir para tentar se livrar do cativeiro.

Características do jogo:
 - Um roguelite cativante em que cada rodada pode ser a última!
 - Rejogabilidade, diversos finais e potencializadores desbloqueáveis!
 - Eleve sua pontuação ao infinito e além no Modo Infinito!
 - Atmosfera sufocante semelhante a de um escape room!
 - Mais de 150 itens e sinergias para aumentar sua sorte!
 - Uma história assustadora sobre vício e fuga!

Observação sobre dados salvos: o jogo armazena o progresso localmente no seu dispositivo. Note que desinstalar o aplicativo (ou limpar os dados de aplicativo) vai excluir seu jogo salvo. Salvamentos em nuvem e sincronização entre dispositivos estão em desenvolvimento para uma atualização futura.

DÚVIDA: É UM JOGO DE APOSTAS?
Não mesmo! CloverPit é roguelite de terror, e não um simulador de caça-níqueis. Nossa máquina caça-níqueis é feita para ser quebrada e derrotada e nunca vai pedir dinheiro de verdade!

pt.description:
O Titan Quest cativou legiões de jogadores desde a sua estreia em 2006. Tu recebes a experiência abrangente de uma jornada desenfreada e verdadeiramente heróica pelos mundos de Titan Quest!

A tua honrosa missão é salvar o mundo!

Sozinhos, os deuses sozinhos não conseguem derrotar os Titãs. Por isso, são necessários heróis reais - e só podes ser tu! O teu sucesso ou fracasso decidirá o destino do povo e dos Olympians! Percorre os mundos místicos e antigos da Grécia, Egito, Babilónia e China com o teu herói personalizado. Conquista as hordas de criaturas lendárias e domina várias armas e artes marciais: tiro com arco, luta de espadas ou o uso de magia poderosa!

Viaja por um mundo de antiguidade e mitologia nórdica!

Luta contra as feras da mitologia enquanto viajas para o Partenon, as Grandes Pirâmides, os Jardins Suspensos da Babilónia, a Grande Muralha, a Arena do Tártaro e outros lugares famosos. Encontra os maiores vilões da mitologia grega, descobre as terras desconhecidas do norte da Europa, procura o reino mítico da Atlântida e faz uma jornada pelo Mediterrâneo Ocidental.

É tudo ou nada no teu caminho glorioso!

A cada desafio que te espera, terás que derrotar inimigos maiores e mais fortes até atingires o teu objetivo e forçar os Titãs a ajoelharem! Corre para a batalha ao lado de bravos companheiros de estimação! Encontra itens extraordinários com poderes especiais que irão melhorar as tuas capacidades e ajudar-te no teu caminho. Espadas lendárias, feitiços de relâmpagos poderosos, magia, arcos e vários outros tesouros com poderes inimagináveis esperam por ti - todos eles estão à tua disposição nas tuas batalhas e espalham medo e terror entre as criaturas horríveis!

De que estás à espera?

Como nenhum outro jogo no género RPG de ação, o Titan Quest: Edição Lendária combina o fascinante mundo da mitologia com a ação interminável e emocionante que esperas de um jogo tão atraente!

Características principais:

- No DLC do Trono Imortal, encontrarás os maiores vilões da mitologia grega, enfrentarás os ataques de Cerberus e arriscarás as margens do Rio Styx. Deves interpretar as profecias do vidente cego Tirésias, lutar ao lado de Agamenon e Aquiles e usar os ardis de Odisseu para conquistar esta nova aventura sombria.

- Nas terras desconhecidas do norte da Europa no Ragnarök DLC, enfrentarás os reinos dos celtas, dos homens do norte e dos deuses Asgardianos!

- Conhece um explorador no DLC Atlantis, em busca do reino mítico da Atlântida. Uma chave está supostamente escondida no diário de Hércules, que dizem estar localizado na cidade fenícia de Gadir. Começa uma jornada pelo Mediterrâneo Ocidental, incluindo a Arena do Tártaro para batalhas épicas!

+ Todas as atualizações importantes foram implementadas no Titan Quest revisto tecnicamente para garantir a melhor experiência de jogo deste clássico de todos os tempos!

+ ETERNAL EMBERS DLCs disponíveis como compra in-app - Invocado pelo lendário Imperador Yao, o Herói é chamado de volta ao Leste para lidar com uma ameaça demoníaca que está devastando a terra depois que o Telkine foi morto.

+ Uma nota para todos os jogadores que possuem a versão básica do Titan Quest: Os DLCs mencionados aqui também serão lançados para compra como conteúdo adicional para que todos os fãs possam atualizar os seus jogos para desfrutarem todas as expansões!

pt.description:
"Mergulhe numa história intensa de corrupção, crimes e intrigas. Encarne o rígido Chefe de Polícia Jack Boyd e fique cara a cara com a escória de Freeburg, uma cidade em queda livre. Será que Jack vai chegar à aposentadoria com uma bolada, esperando para ser gasta, ou vai acabar durango… ou pior ainda?

Seja tragado por este polêmico conto de corrupção, crime e intriga policial. Gerencie sua equipe, atende às emergências e investigue os crimes numa cidade à beira do caos. O submundo da máfia trama por trás dos panos, fincando suas garras cada vez mais fundo na cidade, mesmo o prefeito estando pronto para explorar cada situação para levar vantagem política.

Escolha sua abordagem a cada situação à medida que ela se desenrola. Você às vezes vai reagir a uma crise se desdobrando numa cena de crime, ou negociar com os chefões do crime de Freeburg. Outras vezes, você vai se deparar se esquivando de perguntas feitas numa coletiva de imprensa, ou até mesmo num eventual interrogatório no rol de testemunhas. Será que você consegue evitar que este vulcão entre em erupção, pelo menos até conseguir um bom pé de meia para a aposentadoria? Ou será que você vai acabar atrás das grades — ou pior?"

- Sua missão é simples: Conseguir $ 500.000 em 180 dias, antes de Jack Boyd se aposentar. Como? Aí é com você!

- Decisões, decisões e mais decisões: em miúdos, “This Is the Police” é uma história sombria e como você reage a ela. Qualquer que seja a sua decisão, ela influenciará o jogo — e, portanto, o destino de Jack Boyd.

- O bem, o mal… a escória? O Chefe do Departamento de Polícia de Freeburg lida com todos os tipos de pessoas. Vai de você separar os bons dos maus.

- Cumpra com suas obrigações: Como chefe do DP de Freeburg, Jack deve cuidar das atividades cotidianas: atender às emergências, gerenciar seus policiais, brigar pelo orçamento…

- Comece resolvendo as Investigações e consiga evidências contra as gangues criminosas de Freeburg.

- Negocie com os diferentes poderes da cidade: o prefeito, a máfia, a igreja, o sindicato dos trabalhadores. Todos oferecem favores, mas tudo tem seu preço.

- Dublagem feita totalmente pelo glorioso Jon St. John (vulgo: a voz do Duke Nukem).
